title: Post-Quantum Security of Ascon with Independent Permutations
summary: The existing approach fails when Ascon's two permutations are modeled independently; a post-quantum security proof for that setting remains open.

formal_statement.body: Establish a post-quantum security proof for $\mathrm{Ascon}$ when its underlying permutations $p_a$ and $p_b$ are modeled as independent random permutations; the existing proof approach does not apply under this independence assumption.

scope.domain: Post-quantum security analysis of Ascon under random-permutation modeling.
assumptions: The underlying permutations p_a and p_b are modeled as independent random permutations.
parameters: p_a and p_b: Ascon's underlying permutations
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish a post-quantum security proof for Ascon in the independent-random-permutation model.

citations.label: Post-Quantum Security of Keyed Sponge-Based Constructions through a Modular Approach

progress.summary: The paper presents this as future work after noting that its existing proof approach does not apply when p_a and p_b are modeled as independent permutations.
